title: Guard a recipe
summary: A guard is a rule that decides whether a mixin should run.
introduction: A guard is a rule that decides whether a mixin should run. Your task: Call the mixin with 16px and check what is output.
learningObjectives: Call the mixin with 16px and check what is output.
Explain the example for guard a recipe

blocks.text: A guard is a rule that decides whether a mixin should run. It can choose a style based on an input number.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.
Read the code step by step

items: A Less guard after `when` decides whether that mixin's declarations should be produced for the supplied input.

blocks.text: The h1 rule gets a bold weight because 24px is at least 20px.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A guarded mixin may output nothing when its test is false. Check the built CSS when a style is missing.
